# Piranesi

Read it in a weekend in August. The narrator lives alone in an endless house of marble halls and statues, where tides flood the lower halls and clouds drift through the upper ones.

## What stayed with me

He keeps a careful journal and an index of everything, which made me think about this vault. The calm in the voice carries the whole book.

## Quotes I marked

"The beauty of the House is immeasurable; its kindness infinite."
